---
title: "Minimizing the largest criterion risk"
subtitle: "4.9 · after the postrank theory book, chapter 13"
description: "Comparison of weighted-risk and deterministic minimax report selection."
---

A low weighted-average risk can hide poor performance on one criterion. Compare the weighted-risk optimum with the minimax report that minimizes the larger expected criterion risk.

```{=html}
<div id="app" class="prx-app column-page"></div>
<script src="../../js/vendor/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/vendor/plot.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/bundles/worst-criterion.js"></script>
<script>window.__prxApp = PRX["worst-criterion"].mountWidget(document.getElementById("app"));</script>
```

## Numerical illustrations {#what-to-try}

- **w .90** and **w .70.** Weighted best averages .0605 (worse endpoint .230) at .90, and .0882 (worse endpoint .138) at .70.
- **w .30** and **Score B only.** At .30 both rules select `{A, B, C, D} > {E, F}` (.0944); at 0 two tied weighted reports reach .200 and .211.
- **Book low**, **Book high**, **Book minimax**, and **Zero error weight.** Weighted risk shifts from .250 to .150, while guarding both keeps .250 even at zero weight.
- **Certain opposition.** Two required grades give envelope peak .500 while deterministic minimax is 1.00.

<details>
<summary>Methodological note</summary>

For the minimax calculation, we first take the expected loss on each criterion and then take their maximum.
Averaging the worst loss in each posterior state would define a different decision rule. The chart clips
lines that extend beyond the displayed range, while the accessible table and keyboard view retain every endpoint.
In a restricted report family, the maximum of the weighted minimum can lie strictly below the deterministic minimax risk.
</details>

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="In postrank"}
The package's synthetic minimax example also withholds every pair; it uses its own units.
```r
library(postrank)
source(system.file("scripts", "_vignette-setup.R", package="postrank", mustWork=TRUE), local=TRUE)
mm <- load_or_compute("toy_minimax"); get_grades(mm); get_risk(mm)
```
:::

Standalone: [worst-criterion](../../embed/worst-criterion.html), for example `?preset=high`.
